card.name: Final piece of the word technetium
card.fires_on: The closing piece "ium" of the word Technetium, when it is split into parts. It appears in radiopharmaceutical preparation instructions, usually just before "Tc 99m".

modes.label: Technetium before Tc 99m
modes.description: The word ends in "ium" right before the Tc 99m label and a product name.
modes.example: Procedure for the Preparation of Technet<<ium>> Tc 99m Albumin

modes.label: Lowercase technetium in running text
modes.description: The lowercase word is split, with "ium" followed by a hyphen, "99m", or a generator or procedure term.
modes.example: Elute the technet<<ium>> generator with sodium chloride injection, USP
